note: Names, descriptions and grades are exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Difficulty and time are this guide's estimates, labelled as such. Counts come only from the official descriptions or the trophy-tracking lists cited beside each guide.

trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks automatically the moment you earn the other 54 trophies, so there is no separate task here — the roadmap below is the real guide. Work the stages in order, clear every missable trophy before the final mission, and save the long grinds (stunts, challenges, collectibles) for the cleanup stages after the story.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Follow the 8-stage roadmap in order, starting with the story chapters.
Clear all 7 missable trophies in Stage 3, before the final mission.
Finish the story, then work the stranger strands and side missions.
Sweep the collectibles and activities, then the money and cleanup trophies.
The platinum pops as soon as the 54th other trophy unlocks.
trophies.tip: Check trophies off in this tracker as you earn them — the dashboard shows exactly what is left.

trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the game's opening mission, so this is the first story trophy most players earn. Play through the introduction as directed; there is no choice or side objective that can block it.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start a new game and play the opening sequence.
Follow the on-screen objectives through Gone Fishing.
Finish the mission — the trophy unlocks at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.tip: Unmissable story trophy — just play the opening.

trophies.guide: Chapter 1 sets up Lucia and Jason's story across Leonida. Play every main mission in the chapter in order; side content is optional for this trophy, but use the chapter to learn driving, shooting and the wanted system.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play the main missions of Chapter 1 in the order the game offers them.
Use free-roam gaps to try driving and combat, but keep the story moving.
Finish the chapter's final mission — the trophy unlocks at the chapter card.
trophies.tip: Unmissable story trophy — chapter progress is automatic.

trophies.guide: Chapter 2 raises the stakes and opens more of the map. Keep playing the main missions in order; this is a good chapter to start the stranger strands you pass, since several need multiple visits over time.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play Chapter 2's main missions in order.
Start any stranger strands you meet — they pay off in Stage 5.
Finish the chapter's final mission to unlock the trophy.
trophies.tip: Talk to every stranger marked on the map — strands take a while to finish.

trophies.guide: Chapter 3 brings the story into Vice City itself, with bigger set-piece missions. The difficulty steps up a little — use cover, keep your weapons stocked, and don't rush the driving sections.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play Chapter 3's main missions in order.
Stock up on armour and ammo before the bigger missions.
Finish the chapter's final mission to unlock the trophy.
trophies.tip: Explore Vice City between missions — several activities live here.

trophies.guide: Chapter 4 is the last full chapter before the endgame, and its missions are the toughest of the story so far. Before you start its final missions, check the Missable view — several trophies must be done before the finale.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play Chapter 4's main missions in order.
Before the chapter's last missions, clear the Stage 3 missable trophies.
Finish the chapter's final mission to unlock the trophy.
trophies.tip: Do the Stage 3 missables now — the finale locks some of them out.
trophies.watchout: The final mission follows soon after this chapter — finish missable trophies first.

trophies.guide: The final mission closes the story and pays out a gold trophy. It is long, with several phases — save beforehand if the game offers a manual save, and make sure every missable trophy is already earned, because some content may not be replayable afterwards.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Confirm all 7 missable trophies are earned (see the Missable view).
Stock armour, ammo and snacks before starting the finale.
Play the final mission through its phases to the credits.
The gold trophy unlocks at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.tip: Save before the finale — and earn the missables first.
trophies.watchout: Point of no return: starting the finale may lock missable trophies.

trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is an early story mission that builds the partnership at the heart of the game. Follow the mission markers; the driving and combat here are gentle by design.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Reach Breakfast Run in the story mission list.
Follow the mission objectives as they appear.
Finish the mission — the trophy unlocks at completion.
trophies.tip: Unmissable story trophy — it comes with normal story progress.

trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is one of the story's big set pieces — a planned robbery with a loud escape. Listen to the setup dialogue: it tells you the approach the mission expects, and the escape route matters more than the shooting.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story.
Complete the setup beats as directed.
Execute the heist, then follow the escape route without stopping to fight.
Finish the mission to unlock the trophy.
trophies.tip: Keep moving during the escape — standing still draws more heat.

trophies.guide: Child's Play is a story mission about family ties. It plays as a standard mission with driving and dialogue beats — follow the markers and it completes in one sitting.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Reach Child's Play in the story mission list.
Follow the mission objectives as they appear.
Finish the mission — the trophy unlocks at completion.
trophies.tip: Unmissable story trophy — it comes with normal story progress.

trophies.guide: Headliners is a story mission built around a public event that goes wrong. Expect a mix of driving, stealth and a loud finish — follow the mission's own pacing and don't skip the setup dialogue, which flags the twist.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Reach Headliners in the story mission list.
Play the setup beats, noting what the dialogue warns you about.
Handle the loud finish, then escape as directed.
Finish the mission to unlock the trophy.
trophies.tip: Use cover in the finale — the crowd scene draws heavy fire.

trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown takes the action to Vice City International Airport. The open tarmac makes cover scarce, so move between vehicles and buildings, and keep an escape vehicle in mind before the shooting starts.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in the story.
Move between cover on the open tarmac — don't cross open ground under fire.
Complete the takedown objective, then leave the airport as directed.
Finish the mission to unlock the trophy.
trophies.tip: The airport is wide open — sprint between cover, never across the middle.

trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is the story's hardest mission before the finale — a military-style operation with heavy enemies and a long runtime. Bring your best weapons, full armour, and patience: rushing the fortified sections gets you killed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Stock full armour and your best weapons before starting.
Reach Operation Savage Glory in the story.
Clear fortified sections slowly, using cover and Combat Focus.
Push through the final assault and finish the mission.
trophies.tip: Hardest story mission before the finale — go slow, use cover.

trophies.guide: 100% completion is the long game: story, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and the checklist the game's own stats screen tracks. It is the last gold most players earn. Use this tracker's stages in order and check the in-game completion stat regularly — it tells you exactly which category is short.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story and all stranger strands first.
Clear every collectible set in the Collectibles hub.
Complete the activities, races and challenges in Stage 7.
Check the in-game completion stat to find the missing category.
Finish the last missing items — the gold pops at 100%.
trophies.tip: The in-game stats screen names the missing category — check it often.
trophies.watchout: Missable trophies feed completion too — earn them before the finale.

trophies.guide: Stunts are jumps, near-misses, long airtime and other driving feats the game counts as you drive. The count is 250, per the official description. You will rack up many naturally; the rest come fastest from repeated jumps at a good ramp and near-miss chains on the highway.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Drive aggressively from the start — stunts count from your first hour.
Find a reliable jump ramp and repeat clean jumps for airtime stunts.
Chain near-misses on the highway for driving stunts.
Watch the in-game stunt counter and top it up to 250.
trophies.tip: Don't grind this early — most of the 250 come naturally while playing.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Leonida is full of side activities — races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, shooting ranges, drone races, meditation and more. Try each type once; the trophy pops when the last new type is sampled. The trophy-tracking lists count 9 activity types.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open the map and note the activity icons across Leonida.
Visit each activity type and complete one session of it.
Keep a mental checklist — the trophy pops on the last new type.
trophies.tip: Do this alongside the other activity trophies — one visit each.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: The Shooting Range holds 42 challenges, per the official description, and every one needs a gold medal. This is a skill trophy: learn each weapon's recoil, use Combat Focus where it helps, and replay the hardest challenges in short sessions rather than grinding frustrated.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Find a Shooting Range and clear the easy challenges first.
Learn each weapon's recoil and the gold time or score for each challenge.
Use Combat Focus on precision challenges where it is allowed.
Replay the hardest few in short sessions until all 42 are gold.
trophies.tip: Short sessions beat long grinds — accuracy drops when you are frustrated.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun runs drone races at 14 locations, per the official description. You must win at every one. Learn each course's gates on a practice lap, then race clean — a single missed gate usually costs the win.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find the Top Fun drone race locations on the map.
Fly a practice lap to learn each course's gates.
Race each location and win — 14 wins in total.
Replay any location you lost until you hold all 14 wins.
trophies.tip: Learn the gates first — one missed gate usually costs the race.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Mix cars, bikes and boats so the wins spread across event types, and pick the vehicle class each race favours.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Open the race list and note the events you have not won.
Enter a new race, pick the favoured vehicle class, and win it.
Move to the next unwon race — repeat until 20 different wins.
Check the tracker: re-winning an old race does not count.
trophies.tip: Only new wins count — always pick a race you have not won yet.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal is a fishing rival who offers challenges at the water. Beat him once to earn this trophy — and do it before the finale, because story characters can become unavailable after the story ends. Learn the fishing timing first on a solo session.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.ponr: Before the final mission — Cal's challenges may end with the story
steps: Find Cal at a fishing spot and accept his challenge.
Practise the fishing timing on a solo cast first.
Out-fish Cal in the challenge — the trophy pops on the win.
trophies.tip: Practise solo first, then challenge Cal when the timing feels easy.
trophies.watchout: Missable: Cal may become unavailable after the story ends — do it in Stage 3.

trophies.guide: Find an arcade cabinet — arcades and bars across Leonida hold them — and play one game through to its end. Pick the shortest game on the cabinet; this is a quick trophy once you find a machine.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in an arcade or bar.
Pick the shortest game on the machine.
Play it through to the end screen — the trophy pops.
trophies.tip: Pick the shortest game on the cabinet.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy is one of Leonida's stranger contacts, with a mission strand that builds over several meetings. Keep answering his calls and visiting his marker; the strand ends with a final mission that pays out this trophy.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Meet Andy and start his mission strand.
Return whenever his marker or call appears.
Complete each mission in the strand in order.
Finish Andy's final mission to unlock the trophy.
trophies.tip: Strands advance between story missions — check the map often.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand plays out on the water and around the docks. Like the other stranger strands it advances across several meetings — answer his calls, visit his marker, and the final mission will unlock.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Meet Kenton and start his mission strand.
Return whenever his marker or call appears.
Complete each mission in the strand in order.
Finish Kenton's final mission to unlock the trophy.
trophies.tip: Keep a boat handy — Kenton's missions run on the water.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand is a lone-rider story across Leonida's back roads. Meet him, keep returning when he calls, and work his missions in order until the final one unlocks.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Meet Billy and start his mission strand.
Return whenever his marker or call appears.
Complete each mission in the strand in order.
Finish Billy's final mission to unlock the trophy.
trophies.tip: A fast bike makes Billy's road missions much quicker.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight stranger strands must be completed, per the official description. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of them; three more strangers are scattered across Leonida. Strands advance slowly, so start them all early and check the map between story missions.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Meet every stranger marked on the map and start their strands.
Finish the five named strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone.
Find and finish three more stranger strands across Leonida.
The silver pops when the eighth strand's final mission completes.
trophies.tip: Start all strands early — they advance between story missions.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy runs a supply-and-demand strand — fetch work with a criminal twist. Meet him, keep his jobs moving, and the strand closes with a final mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Meet Randy and start his mission strand.
Return whenever his marker or call appears.
Complete each mission in the strand in order.
Finish Randy's final mission to unlock the trophy.
trophies.tip: Randy's jobs pay well — a handy money source for the spending trophies.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand spins around Vice City's nightlife. Meet him, answer his calls, and work his missions in order until the final one unlocks this trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Meet Tyrone and start his mission strand.
Return whenever his marker or call appears.
Complete each mission in the strand in order.
Finish Tyrone's final mission to unlock the trophy.
trophies.tip: Tyrone's missions cluster at night — check the map after dark.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditation spots across Leonida, per the official description. Each is a quiet scenic point — sit, meditate, and move on. They are relaxing by design; the only work is travelling to all 18.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: Note the meditation spot markers on the map.
Visit each spot and meditate — 18 in total.
Sweep region by region so none is missed.
trophies.tip: Sweep region by region — the spots cluster by area.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret is a hunting contact who wants one unique animal. Meet him to learn which animal and where it roams, then track it quietly — a scoped rifle and patience beat a loud approach.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Meet Bret and take the hunting job.
Travel to the animal's territory he names.
Track it quietly with a scoped rifle and take the shot.
Return to Bret to complete the hunt.
trophies.tip: Move slowly and use a scoped rifle — the animal spooks easily.

trophies.guide: Collectible cards hide all over Leonida, in shops, bars, houses and odd corners. Three full sets are needed for this silver, per the official description. Pick up every card you see from the start — backtracking for one missing card is the painful part.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Pick up every collectible card you see from the start of the game.
Check shops, bars and interiors as you travel.
Track your sets in the in-game collection screen.
Complete the third set to unlock the silver.
trophies.tip: Grab cards as you go — backtracking for one card is the painful part.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It is the in-world photo-sharing app — snap a photo at 100 different locations, per the official description. The counter only rises at new spots, so keep moving and photograph landmarks, beaches, neighbourhoods and viewpoints as you explore.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the WAiNK app and snap a photo at your current location.
Photograph a new location everywhere you travel — landmarks and viewpoints count.
Watch the counter; only new locations raise it.
Reach 100 distinct locations to unlock the silver.
trophies.tip: Photograph everywhere you go — the 100 comes fastest while exploring.

trophies.guide: Challenges are the game's rotating feats — driving, shooting, flying and stranger tasks tracked in the challenges menu. Complete 50 of them. Clear the easy ones first, then work the categories that match your strengths.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open the challenges menu and note the easiest uncompleted ones.
Clear the easy challenges first across all categories.
Work the categories that match your strengths.
Reach 50 completed challenges to unlock the trophy.
trophies.tip: Easy challenges first — the menu shows exactly what each needs.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. Do this before the finale — your partner is only beside you during the story. A fast car and the back roads beat a shootout.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.ponr: Before the final mission — needs your partner beside you
steps: Wait for a story moment when your partner is with you.
Build a 4-star wanted level — keep escalating until the fourth star shows.
Break line of sight and drive the back roads until the heat fades.
The trophy pops when the wanted level clears with your partner present.
trophies.tip: Back roads and tunnels break line of sight faster than highways.
trophies.watchout: Missable: your partner is only with you during the story — do it in Stage 3.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob three shops in a row while keeping your wanted level the whole time — don't let the heat drop between robberies. Pick three close shops, move fast, and don't stop to fight the police.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.ponr: Before the final mission — needs your partner beside you
steps: With your partner present, pick three shops close together.
Rob the first shop to gain a wanted level.
Drive straight to the second and third shops and rob them too.
Keep the wanted level alive throughout — the trophy pops after the third.
trophies.tip: Three close shops, no fighting police — speed keeps the heat alive.
trophies.watchout: Missable: needs your partner beside you — do it in Stage 3.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles, per the official description — sit in a new vehicle and it counts. Variety is the key: cars, bikes, boats, planes and work vehicles all count, so try everything you pass instead of sticking to one favourite ride.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Sit in every new vehicle you pass — each new model counts.
Try boats, planes, bikes and work vehicles, not just cars.
Check the vehicle log to see what is still missing.
Reach 100 discovered vehicles.
trophies.tip: Try everything you pass — variety, not mileage, is what counts.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus slows time and sharpens your aim for a short window. To drop five enemies in one use, find a group of five clustered enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and work through them quickly with headshots before the window ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a spot where five or more enemies cluster together.
Trigger Combat Focus when they are grouped and exposed.
Drop five with quick headshots before the window ends.
Retry at the same spot if you fall short — enemy groups respawn.
trophies.tip: Wait for a tight cluster — five spread-out enemies won't fall in time.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: VCIA is Vice City International Airport. An unscheduled departure means leaving the airport in a way the timetable never planned — grab a plane and take off without clearance, or leave the tarmac by an unofficial route. Expect a wanted level.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Enter VCIA and reach the tarmac.
Take a plane and lift off without clearance — or leave by an unofficial route.
Escape the airport area to complete the departure.
trophies.tip: Expect a wanted level — have an escape route planned.

trophies.guide: Rhinos are the game's military tanks. This trophy is about dealing with one — the description is deliberately vague, but the trophy-tracking lists agree it involves a Rhino tank encounter. Reach a high wanted level or a military area to draw one out, then handle it on the game's terms.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Raise your wanted level high or head to a military area to draw out a Rhino.
Engage the tank as the situation demands — explosives and cover help.
Survive the encounter and clear the scene.
The trophy pops once the Rhino situation is resolved.
trophies.tip: Explosives and cover — never stand in the open against a tank.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: A clean jewelry heist: get in, take the goods, and leave with nobody ever knowing you were there. Scout the store first, move when the staff look away, and never trigger an alarm — one detection voids the attempt.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Scout the jewelry store — note staff patrols and camera angles.
Enter quietly and move only when staff look away.
Take the goods without triggering any alarm.
Leave undetected — the trophy pops on a clean exit.
trophies.tip: One detection voids the run — patience beats speed here.
trophies.watchout: Being spotted at any point voids the attempt — restart clean.

trophies.guide: Five bank vaults must be robbed, with an escape after each one, per the official description. Each bank is a mini-heist: plan the entry, crack the vault, then lose the police before the next. Space them out — the heat from one robbery should be cold before the next.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Pick a bank and plan the entry and escape route.
Rob the vault, then lose the police completely.
Repeat at four more banks — five vaults in total.
The silver pops after the fifth clean escape.
trophies.tip: Let the heat cool fully between banks — stacked wanted levels are brutal.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks patrol Leonida's roads on set routes. Stop one, crack it open, grab the cash and lose the police. A roadblock with your own vehicle works better than a chase — force the truck to stop, then move fast.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck on its patrol route.
Force it to stop — a roadblock beats a chase.
Crack the truck and grab the cash.
Lose the police to complete the escape.
trophies.tip: Block the road ahead of the truck — don't chase it.

trophies.guide: Explore every corner of Leonida — the trophy-tracking lists count 52 areas to visit. Drive, fly and sail across the whole map; the in-game area counter shows what is still dark. Sweep the map region by region so no remote corner is missed.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Open the map and note the areas still unexplored.
Sweep region by region — Vice City, the coast, the swamps, the keys.
Use a plane or helicopter for remote islands and corners.
The trophy pops when the last of the 52 areas is visited.
trophies.tip: A helicopter makes the remote corners far quicker.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Every gang in Leonida runs illegal operations — stash houses, labs and fronts. Rob one operation belonging to each gang; the trophy-tracking lists count 9 gangs. Expect each gang to fight back, so hit one operation, cool down, then move to the next.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find an illegal operation on the map and note which gang owns it.
Rob it and escape, then let the heat cool.
Repeat for a different gang each time — 9 gangs in total.
The trophy pops after the ninth gang's operation is robbed.
trophies.tip: One gang at a time — let the heat cool between hits.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A quiet moment: head to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a sea view, and order a cocktail. Sit, enjoy the view, and the trophy pops. Do it during the story for the full atmosphere — and because it is the kind of small moment players forget until cleanup.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Head to Ocean Beach and find a bar with a sea view.
Order a cocktail and enjoy it with the view.
The trophy pops once the moment completes.
trophies.tip: A two-minute trophy — do it whenever you pass Ocean Beach.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: A nod to the series' past: drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's front window and out the other side. Pick a showroom with a clear run-up, build speed, and aim for the glass.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Find a vehicle showroom with a clear run-up.
Pick a fast car and build speed on the approach.
Smash through the showroom window and out the other side.
The trophy pops on the exit.
trophies.tip: A clear run-up matters more than top speed.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kolt & Associates runs a bowling alley in Leonida. Play a full game there — follow through on every frame to the end. No score target is named, so just finish the game.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Start a game of bowling.
Play every frame through to the end — the trophy pops.
trophies.tip: No score target — just finish the game.

trophies.guide: A cryptic description for a story partnership moment — the trophy-tracking lists tie it to a public moment between the two leads. It is flagged missable here because story partnership moments can pass without replay; do the story's public set pieces thoroughly and it should unlock before the finale.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.ponr: Before the final mission — tied to a story partnership moment
steps: Play the story's partnership set pieces in full — don't skip them.
Take the public, showy option when the mission offers a choice.
Check the tracker after each big partnership moment.
If it has not popped by Chapter 4, replay the partnership missions.
trophies.tip: Don't skip partnership set pieces — the moment hides inside one.
trophies.watchout: Missable: story partnership moments can pass without replay — do it in Stage 3.

trophies.guide: Choices made across the story — for better or worse. The trophy tracks the decisions you make in story moments, and the tracking lists note PlayStation counts them toward 500. Make choices deliberately as you play; they lock in as the story moves on, so this is flagged missable.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.ponr: Choices lock in as you play — decide before the final mission
steps: Take every story choice seriously — each one counts.
Don't leave decisions for later; they lock in as the story moves on.
Keep playing through the story's choice moments.
The trophy pops once the required choices are made.
trophies.tip: Choices lock in — decide in the moment, don't postpone.
trophies.watchout: Missable: choices lock in as you play and may not be replayable.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — succeed at something on your second try. The tracking lists tie this to a retry: fail a specific attempt, then succeed on the immediate retry. If you succeed first time everywhere, you may need to deliberately fail and retry a mission beat before the finale.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.ponr: Before the final mission — needs a failed first attempt you can retry
steps: Find a mission beat or challenge you can fail and retry.
Fail the attempt once, then retry it immediately.
Succeed on the second try — the trophy pops.
Do it before the finale, while retryable beats remain.
trophies.tip: If you never fail, deliberately fail once — then succeed on the retry.
trophies.watchout: Missable: needs a retryable beat — do it before the finale.

trophies.guide: A one-off strange event somewhere in Leonida — the description gives nothing away, and the tracking lists keep it vague too. Strange events in GTA games hide in odd places at odd times; explore the map's weird corners, especially at night, and this should trigger before the finale.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.ponr: Before the final mission — a one-off strange event
steps: Explore Leonida's odd corners, especially at night.
Investigate anything strange — lights, sounds, unusual markers.
Trigger the event and see it through.
Do it before the finale, while the world is still fully open.
trophies.tip: Night-time exploration finds the strange stuff faster.
trophies.watchout: Missable: a one-off event — do it before the finale.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by: swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and knock someone over. A slow drive past a pedestrian with a well-timed swing does it — a bike is easiest, since the swing is unobstructed.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Equip a melee weapon and get on a bike.
Ride slowly past a pedestrian.
Swing as you pass to knock them over.
The trophy pops on a clean melee drive-by.
trophies.tip: A bike is easiest — the swing is unobstructed.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills are dirty cash you earn from robberies and heists; launder $250,000 of them through your contacts, per the official description. Launder as you earn — don't sit on a pile of marked bills, and use the contacts the story introduces.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies and heists.
Visit a laundering contact and launder what you hold.
Repeat as you earn — the counter tracks $250,000 total.
The trophy pops at $250,000 laundered.
trophies.tip: Launder as you earn — don't sit on marked bills.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, per the official description. Clothes, weapons, ammo, food, car mods — it all counts. This comes naturally over a full playthrough; if it hasn't popped by cleanup, buy the big-ticket items you've been putting off.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend normally as you play — clothes, weapons, ammo and mods all count.
Check your spending total late in the game.
Buy big-ticket items you have been putting off to reach $100,000.
trophies.tip: Comes naturally — top it up with big purchases in cleanup.

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in Leonida — the trophy-tracking lists count 8. Garages unlock as you progress and cost money, so save for them in the late game and buy each one as it becomes available.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Note the garage properties for sale on the map.
Save money through the story for the purchases.
Buy each garage as it becomes available — 8 in total.
The trophy pops on the last purchase.
trophies.tip: Save for garages late-game — they unlock as you progress.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Scooter Bros is the in-world vehicle app. Register 10 vehicles to it, per the official description — find a vehicle, open the app, and register it. Ten different vehicles, so use the variety you find while exploring.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Find a vehicle and open the Scooter Bros app.
Register the vehicle to the app.
Repeat with 9 more different vehicles.
The trophy pops on the tenth registration.
trophies.tip: Register every new vehicle you drive — the 10 comes fast.
